title: Bayangan Ganjil di Lobi Malam
theme: Seorang satpam malam mengamati pola aneh yang berulang di lobi apartemen, membawanya pada penemuan kecil yang mengubah rutinitasnya.

cover.prompt: A tranquil apartment lobby at night, enveloped in a profound quietude. The space is illuminated by gentle, warm interior lighting, creating a comforting ambiance. Subtle architectural lines and textures, a soft glow from a distant reception area, conveying a sense of serene stillness. An indistinct, solitary figure is vaguely perceptible in the deep background, contributing to the quiet vigil.
cover.style: Cinematic photography, shallow depth of field, warm color grading

meta.plan_summary: A night security guard, Pak Jaya, notices a recurring strange shadow in an apartment lobby. His mild obsession leads him to set up a hidden camera, revealing an elderly resident secretly feeding a stray cat, transforming his initial anxiety into warm understanding and contentment.
meta.target_emotion: Mild curiosity evolving into warm understanding and contentment.
